Prophecy: Paul to Bear Witness at Rome
ProphecySummary: After Paul's testimony in Jerusalem, the Lord stands by him at night and says that as he has testified in Jerusalem, so he must bear witness also at Rome.
Fulfillment: Fulfilled in Acts: Paul is sent to Rome under guard after his appeal to Caesar and preaches the kingdom of God there (Acts 28:16-31). Paul's earlier purpose to see Rome (Acts 19:21) is the same expectation, stated before the Lord's promise.
